latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Generator Meta skill.
- Generate AI-powered videos from text prompts, scripts, or clips; supports MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF up to 500MB.
- Handles uploads, editing, generation, and export of videos with easy API integration.
- Cloud backend delivers 1080p MP4 videos in about 1–2 minutes per job.
- Session management, authentication, and error handling are automated for a seamless user experience.
- Includes built-in routing for actions like uploading, checking credits, exporting, and real-time edit workflows.
